representation: Celestia contributors’ reconstruction inspired by Lucy images, uniformly scaled to the published 738 m volume-equivalent diameter. This is an authored approximation, not the mission photogrammetric shape model. The grid marks missing qualified surface imagery.
radiusMeaning: Published volume-equivalent radius used for uniform model scaling
citations: Lucy discovery, ridge and contact-binary satellite
Revised shape, geology and 738 m equivalent diameter
limitations: JPL supplies the heliocentric orbit. The reconstruction has an illustrative meridian; its detailed geometry and unseen hemisphere are not measured terrain.

sourceSelection.missionImages: Encounter images establish resolved shape, but a camera-controlled texture is not yet qualified.

celestia.status: Selected attributed authored reconstruction; not a mission mesh. Original UVs preserved but texture omitted because observed-versus-filled coverage is undocumented.

sourceSelection.imagery: Shared missing-imagery grid. No stock rock texture, inferred albedo, or invented terrain.
